body.name: Certified nuisance-region and clustering handle
body.construction: Start from \(\mathsf{Handle}_{\mathrm{cert}}\): build simultaneous primitive confidence regions, enumerate support clusters and simplex faces consistent with them, retain exactly observed within-cell offsets, compactify unresolved translations and face offsets through \(\Gamma_\eta^{G,R}\), enclose Gaussian probabilities by deterministic interval arithmetic, spend an explicit tail and nuisance-exclusion budget, and return the rate-preserving DKW fallback if certification exceeds a deterministic work budget.
